:::{#exm-disproof}
#### A disproof

Claim: every [prime](number-systems.qmd#def-prime) is [odd](number-systems.qmd#def-odd).

[Disproof](#def-disproof): the [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) $2$ is prime,
and $2$ is not odd,
since $2 = 2k + 1$ would need $k = 1/2$,
which is not an integer.
So there is a prime that is not odd,
which is the [negation](#def-not) of the claim.

This disproof gives a [counterexample](#def-counterexample), $2$.

:::
